data_fields.name: respawn_s
data_fields.donor_constant: per spawn point, seconds (spawn2 respawn value)

data_fields.name: variance_s
data_fields.donor_constant: per spawn point, spread is +/- variance/2 seconds

data_fields.name: group_spawn_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: per spawn group; below 1 means no limit

data_fields.name: entry_npc_spawn_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: per group entry, cached from npc_types; below 1 means no limit

data_fields.name: npc_type_spawn_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: per NPC type; checked again after the pick

data_fields.name: entry_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: weight per group entry; roll in [0, total-1]

data_fields.name: despawn_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 none, 1 respawn-lifetime then instant replace, 2 despawn_timer replace, 3 respawn-lifetime then depop, 4 despawn_timer then depop

best_idea: A spawn point owns its own respawn timer with variance, a weighted pick skips types and groups at their cap, and a per-point lifetime rule depops and re-rolls.
decision_why: Take the per-point respawn timer with variance and the type and group caps for zone population (row 23); reject the numbered despawn modes and the engaged path, which as read spawns a second NPC at the same point.
acceptance: Server test: a zone group capped at 3 live NPCs never has more than 3 live after 10 kills; each point's respawn falls inside respawn +/- variance/2 s; an NPC with aggro is never replaced.
